answer: Reaching eligibility takes 64 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The quill register is checked at draw time, juniper lists the eligible set, and willow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 64 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Slashing removes 61 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
